fair_value_policy: Fair Value V2.1 is the sole valuation baseline. This semantic event must not directly overwrite official numeric macro series or Fair Value.
observed_evidence: UK Maritime Trade Operations reported that a vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile. A fire broke out and the crew was evacuated with local authorities assisting.

Reuters reported that the Saudi East-West Pipeline remained shut after the prior drone attack and that traders and industry sources said the outage could threaten roughly 4% of global oil supply unless pumping resumes within days.
The East-West Pipeline has been a key alternative export route while normal Strait of Hormuz flows are constrained.
semantic_interpretation: The risk has moved beyond a single infrastructure attack into simultaneous pressure on both maritime transit through Hormuz and Saudi Arabia's principal bypass route. This raises the probability that delivered crude and refined-product costs remain elevated and increases persistence risk for inflation, freight, insurance, rates and global-demand channels. The 4% figure is a Reuters-reported supply-risk estimate from traders/sources, not an official production statistic and must remain semantic evidence rather than overwrite any official numeric series.
